title: Some fires go out only in better company.
summary: Guru does not tell the doubting mind to solve itself alone. Guru sends it toward saint company and shared remembrance.
lifeApplication: Make one concrete move toward company that makes Naam easier, not noisier.

source.shortMeaning: Saint company cools the body and changes the outcome of the crossing.
source.lifeApplication: Let belonging become part of your discipline.

evidence.coreClaim: Saint company cools the body and changes the outcome of the crossing.
evidence.turn: Stop circling and let Guru's word take residence.
evidence.practicalImplication: Make one concrete move toward company that makes Naam easier, not noisier.
